note: Illinois has a practical shortcut worth knowing: if a facility has broken state licensing standards, you can call the child abuse hotline and say you want to make a licensing complaint. That is the state's own advice, and it saves working out which of the licensing offices covers a program. Every complaint about a licensed clinician, whatever the profession, goes to one intake unit at IDFPR.

channels.name: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation, Division of Professional Regulation
channels.what_it_can_do: Licenses and disciplines professional counselors, clinical social workers, psychologists and marriage and family therapists among more than a hundred professions, and investigates complaints against any of them through one Complaint Intake Unit.
channels.who_to_report: Any licensed mental health professional in Illinois. Complaints are accepted from clients, families, colleagues and anybody else.
channels.how: File through the Division's complaint page. The licensee is notified of the allegations in writing once it is logged.

channels.name: Illinois DCFS Licensing
channels.what_it_can_do: Licenses child care and child welfare facilities in Illinois against state licensing standards, and investigates complaints that a facility has breached them.
channels.who_to_report: A facility you believe has broken licensing standards - staffing, supervision, conditions, how children are treated.
channels.how: Complain to the local DCFS Licensing Office, or call the Child Abuse Hotline and say you want to make a licensing complaint. Complaints can be made by post, email, fax or in person.
channels.phone_note: The Child Abuse Hotline also takes licensing complaints - say that is what you are calling about.

channels.name: Illinois DCFS Child Abuse Hotline
channels.what_it_can_do: The statewide 24-hour line for reporting a child harmed or at risk of harm through abuse or neglect, and the route into a DCFS investigation.
channels.who_to_report: A child at an Illinois program.

channels.name: Equip for Equality
channels.what_it_can_do: Illinois's Protection and Advocacy agency, with federal authority to investigate abuse and neglect of people with disabilities in facilities, a right of access to them, and free legal advocacy.
channels.who_to_report: An Illinois program where the young person has a disability or a mental health diagnosis.
